description: DataForSEO MCP server is a useful solution for on-demand SEO automation. Fetch SEO and marketing data from DataForSEO APIs without leaving chat; look up keyword search volume, ranking difficulty scores, and related keyword ideas; pull live Google SERP results for any query; review backlinks, referring domains, competitor profiles, and more.
